state.question: Has Cirrus Connect's operating change resolved the question about on-time operations? Focus on: September arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.
state.conclusion: Cirrus introduced a revised hub schedule.
state.gap: September arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Cirrus Connect's strategy in on-time operations, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Cirrus Connect, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Cirrus Connect's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Cleo Das's Dispatch's dispatch on Cirrus Connect, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Cirrus Connect features in a field guide to on-time operations. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a tourism guide describes a scenic arrival without flight movement records.

candidates.title: Cirrus Connect: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Cirrus operations return supports a dated assessment of september arrival punctuality within fifteen minutes and the change from August under the same definition.
